description: Properties for multi pump usage of a pump.

DistributionPriority.description: This property describes in ascending order the priority of pumps in addition operation mode.
DistributionPriority.title: DistributionPriority

DistributionType.description: This property describes the share of operation time of different pumps of the pump system in addition operation mode.
DistributionType.title: DistributionType

ExchangeMode.description: This property specifies the exchange mode of the pump
ExchangeMode.title: ExchangeMode

ExchangeTime.description: This property specifies the determination of the absolute time for the next exchange of the pump, if operator specific Pump Exchange Mode is activated.
ExchangeTime.title: ExchangeTime

ExchangeTimeDifference.description: This property specifies the determination of the time for the next exchange of the pump relative to ExchangeTime, if operator specific Pump Exchange Mode is activated.
ExchangeTimeDifference.title: ExchangeTimeDifference

MaximumNumberOfPumpsInOperation.description: This property specifies the maximum number of pumps in operation. The difference between NumberOfPumps and MaximumNumberOfPumpsInOperation identifies the redundant pumps.
MaximumNumberOfPumpsInOperation.title: MaximumNumberOfPumpsInOperation

MultiPumpOperationMode.description: This property specifies the actual multi pump operation mode. In redundant operation mode a pump fulfils the process function of another pump. Addition operation mode characterizes the supplementary fulfilling of the process function. The mixed mode characterizes both operation tasks.
MultiPumpOperationMode.title: MultiPumpOperationMode

NumberOfPumps.description: This property identifies the number of pumps in multi pump management
NumberOfPumps.title: NumberOfPumps

PumpCollectiveIDs.description: This element identifies the pumps within the pump system
PumpCollectiveIDs.title: PumpCollectiveIDs

PumpRole.description: This property identifies the role rsp. task of the pump within the multi pump management.
PumpRole.title: PumpRole

RedundantPumpIDs.description: This property identifies the actual redundant pumps within the pump system
RedundantPumpIDs.title: RedundantPumpIDs
